newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RINGGIT RANGEBOUND, SEEN TRACKING DOLLAR/MAJORS.
newsitem.headline: RINGGIT RANGEBOUND, SEEN TRACKING DOLLAR/MAJORS.

text.p: * Ringgit rangebound on lack of fresh domestic factors
* Local bids for dollar/ringgit at 2.6330/40 met by offshore selling at 2.6350/60
The ringgit was rangebound in early Asian trading on Thursday due to lack of fresh factors, with its direction likely to be influenced by dollar/majors movements, dealers said.
"There's no factors to move dollar/ringgit. It will continue trading in the 2.6250-2.6450 range," said a dealer with a European bank in Kuala Lumpur.
He said the market will track dollar/majors for trading directions.
At 0230 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.6350/70 to a dollar, against its 2.6350/80 close in Kuala Lumpur on Wednesday.
Dealers said local bids for dollar/ringgit at 2.6330/40 was met by offshore selling at 2.6350/60.
They said there was talk that many offshore players were looking to sell dollars above 2.6400.
